$comment: Every package and version the site is built from. This is the only file you edit to add a package or open a documentation version; scripts/pull-docs.mjs does the rest.

database.label: Database
database.description: A thin PDO layer with named connections, a query builder, forward-only results, and nested transactions.

schema.label: Schema
schema.description: Describe a table once and compile the DDL for MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite or SQL Server.

collection.label: Collection
collection.description: Ordered collections with integer or string keys, in a mutable and an immutable variant.

entity.label: Entity
entity.description: Map a class to a table with attributes, then read and write it through a typed store.

migration.label: Migration
migration.description: Versioned schema changes over Database and Schema. A scaffold; no public API yet.
